section.content: The utility model discloses a gene detection equipment for biological gene engineering, including gene detection equipment body, this internal detection chamber that is equipped with of gene detection equipment detects on the top inner wall in chamber fixed mounting has ultraviolet ray sterilization lamp and two articulated seats, and the bottom of two articulated seats all articulates there is the refractor, and two refractors are the slope setting, and the equal fixed mounting in one side that two refractors kept away from each other has the semicircle ring, equal fixedly connected with haulage rope on two semicircle rings, and the equal fixed mounting in one side that two refractors kept away from each other has curved spring. The utility model relates to a rationally, the practicality is good, can fully shine every corner in detecting the intracavity to the ultraviolet ray light that ultraviolet sterilizing lamp sent, has improved the sterilization effect to detecting intracavity portion, and to detecting intracavity portion's sterilization more thoroughly, can not cause the influence to the testing result when being convenient for next time detect, guarantee testing result's accuracy.

本实用新型公开了一种用于生物基因工程的基因检测设备，包括基因检测设备本体，所述基因检测设备本体内设有检测腔，检测腔的顶部内壁上固定安装有紫外线灭菌灯和两个铰接座，两个铰接座的底部均铰接有折射镜，两个折射镜均为倾斜设置，两个折射镜相互远离的一侧均固定安装有半圆环，两个半圆环上均固定连接有牵引绳，两个折射镜相互远离的一侧均固定安装有弯簧。本实用新型设计合理，实用性好，能够把紫外线灭菌灯发出的紫外线光充分照射在检测腔内的每个角落，提高了对检测腔内部的灭菌消毒效果，对检测腔内部的灭菌消毒更加彻底，便于下次检测时不会对检测结果造成影响，保证检测结果的准确性。

Gene detection equipment for biological gene engineeringTechnical Field

The utility model relates to a gene detection technical field specifically is a gene detection equipment for biological genetic engineering.

Background

The gene is a genetic basic unit, a DNA or RNA sequence carrying genetic information is copied to transmit the genetic information to the next generation to guide the synthesis of protein to express the genetic information carried by the gene, thereby controlling the property expression of an organism individual, the gene detection is a technology for detecting the DNA by blood, other body fluids or cells, and the gene detection is a method for taking peripheral venous blood or other tissue cells of a detected person, amplifying the gene information, detecting DNA molecular information in the cells of the detected person by a specific device, analyzing the gene type and the gene defect contained in the DNA molecular information and whether the expression function of the gene defect is normal or not, thereby leading people to know the genetic information of the gene, determining the etiology or predicting the risk of the body suffering from a certain disease, diagnosing the disease by the gene detection technology, predicting the disease risk by the gene detection technology, detecting the mutant gene causing the genetic disease, the most widely used gene detection is the detection of newborn hereditary diseases, the diagnosis of hereditary diseases and the auxiliary diagnosis of some common diseases, and in the gene detection process, the gene detection equipment is one of the indispensable detection equipment, and the liquid to be detected needs to be put into a detection cavity in the gene detection equipment for detection experiment.

However, in the prior art, when a common gene detection device is used, the common gene detection device does not have the function of sterilizing and disinfecting the detection cavity, after the liquid to be detected is put into the detection cavity for gene detection, bacteria in the detection liquid can remain in the detection cavity, and the remaining bacteria can enter the liquid to be detected when the liquid is detected next time, so that the next detection result can be affected, and the detection result is inaccurate.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

Technical problem to be solved

The utility model provides a not enough to prior art, the utility model provides a gene detection equipment for biological gene engineering has solved current gene detection equipment and has not had the sterile function of disinfecting to detecting the chamber, puts into the liquid that detects the detection intracavity and carries out the gene detection and accomplish the back, and the bacterium that detects in the liquid can remain in detecting the intracavity, and remaining bacterium can get into when detecting next and detect in the liquid to can exert an influence to the testing result next time, cause the unsafe problem of testing result.

(II) technical scheme

In order to achieve the above object, the utility model provides a following technical scheme: a gene detection device for biological gene engineering comprises a gene detection device body, wherein a detection cavity is arranged in the gene detection device body, an ultraviolet sterilization lamp and two hinging seats are fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the top of the detection cavity, the bottoms of the two hinging seats are respectively hinged with a refractor, the two refractors are obliquely arranged, a semicircular ring is fixedly arranged on one side, away from each other, of each refractor, a traction rope is fixedly connected onto each semicircular ring, a bent spring is fixedly arranged on one side, away from each other, of each refractor, the top ends of the two bent springs are respectively fixedly connected with the inner wall of the top of the detection cavity, an outer cover is fixedly arranged on the top of the gene detection device body, the bottom of the outer cover is of an open structure, two fixing seats positioned in the outer cover are fixedly arranged on the top of the gene detection device body, and mounting holes are formed in one sides, close to each other, of the two fixing seats, rotate in two mounting holes and install same connecting axle, the both ends of connecting axle extend to outside the corresponding mounting hole respectively, the equal fixed mounting in both ends of connecting axle has the crank, it is equipped with the sleeve all to rotate the cover on two crank, two through-holes have been seted up on the top inner wall of gene test equipment body, two through-holes all are linked together with the dustcoat is inside, corresponding through-hole is run through respectively on the top of two haulage ropes, and the bottom of two haulage ropes respectively with corresponding sleeve fixed connection, fixed cover is equipped with the first gear that is located between two fixing bases on the connecting axle, be equipped with the motor in the dustcoat, the output shaft fixed mounting of motor has the second gear, the second gear meshes with first gear mutually.

Preferably, a multi-control switch is fixedly mounted at the top of the gene detection device body, and a plurality of control buttons are mounted on the multi-control switch.

Preferably, the two refractors are symmetrically arranged at two sides of the ultraviolet sterilization lamp.

Preferably, bearing seats are fixedly mounted on the inner walls of the two sides of the outer cover, and one ends, far away from each other, of the two crank throws are respectively rotatably mounted on the corresponding bearing seats.

Preferably, the top of the gene detection device body is fixedly provided with a motor base positioned in the outer cover, and the motor is fixedly arranged on the motor base.

Preferably, the connecting shaft is fixedly sleeved with two bearings, and outer rings of the two bearings are fixedly connected with the inner walls of the corresponding mounting holes respectively.

(III) advantageous effects

The utility model provides a gene detection equipment for biological genetic engineering. The method has the following beneficial effects:

the gene detection equipment for biological gene engineering is characterized in that an ultraviolet sterilizing lamp is turned on to work, ultraviolet light emitted by the ultraviolet sterilizing lamp irradiates in a detection cavity, residual bacteria inside the detection cavity can be sterilized and disinfected, the motor drives a second gear to rotate by starting the motor, the second gear drives a connecting shaft and two cranks to rotate, the two cranks drive corresponding sleeves to rotate, the two sleeves respectively lift corresponding traction ropes upwards to enable the two sleeves to rotate on the corresponding cranks, the two traction ropes pull the corresponding refractors to rotate at respective hinged positions, the two bent springs are stressed and deformed to generate elasticity, under the action of the elasticity generated by the two bent springs, the two refractors swing in a reciprocating manner, and light emitted by the ultraviolet sterilizing lamp irradiates on the two refractors, utilize the refractor to refract the ultraviolet ray to the reciprocal swing of two refractors of cooperation can fully shine every corner in detecting the intracavity to ultraviolet ray light, has improved the sterilization disinfection effect to detecting intracavity portion, and is more thorough to the sterilization disinfection of detecting intracavity portion, can not cause the influence to the testing result when being convenient for next time detect, guarantees the accuracy of testing result.

To sum up, the gene detection device for the bio-genetic engineering can be obtained by turning on the ultraviolet sterilizing lamp 3 to work, irradiating ultraviolet light emitted by the ultraviolet
